root_cause: Both NodeJS API test jobs failed due to transient outbound network connectivity problems in the CI runner environment, unrelated to the PR's actual code changes (src/plugins/intel_gpu GPU paged-attention kernel selection). Job 24 timed out fetching a test model fixture from raw.githubusercontent.com (DNS/network reachability or GitHub raw-content CDN slowness causing a 30s client-side timeout in tests/setup.js), and job 26 failed a slow/stalled npm actions-cache restore (getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN against productionresultssa0.blob.core.windows.net, Azure Blob Storage used by the actions/cache backend) which then stalled until the step was cancelled after roughly 9 minutes. Neither failure touches the PR's changed files (paged_attention_opt.cpp / paged_attention_gpu_test.cpp), confirming this is infrastructure/network noise rather than a regression introduced by the PR.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally; it depends on transient runner network conditions. To approximate: run `node ./tests/setup.js` in src/bindings/js/node with a throttled/blocked connection to raw.githubusercontent.com, or run `npm run test --loglevel=silly` on a runner with degraded connectivity to *.blob.core.windows.net (actions/setup-node's npm cache restore).
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed merge-queue jobs; this is a transient network failure.

Consider raising the test_setup.js download timeout (currently 30000 ms) or adding a retry-with-backoff around the raw.githubusercontent.com fetch to reduce single-timeout flakiness (src/bindings/js/node/tests/setup.js).

Consider mirroring frequently-used test fixtures (test_model_fp32.xml) to an OpenVINO-controlled/faster artifact store instead of raw.githubusercontent.com to reduce dependency on GitHub raw CDN availability.

Monitor recurrence of the actions/cache 'getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN productionresultssa0.blob.core.windows.net' failure across other workflows; if it recurs broadly it may indicate a GitHub Actions infrastructure incident rather than an OpenVINO-side issue.
prevention_strategies: Add retry/backoff logic around external downloads performed during JS test setup, and treat actions/cache restore failures as non-fatal (cache miss) rather than letting them stall the job for minutes. Track recurrence of this signature in the pattern database; if it crosses the 3-in-12h threshold, escalate for infra investigation.
historical_context: A similar but distinct JS API model-download failure (HTTP 503 from raw.githubusercontent.com, pattern ffd22b8ddfd9b602) was recorded once on 2026-09-17 (PR #38121, run 35243871525). This is the first recorded occurrence of a client-side 30s timeout (rather than a 503) for the same download step; both point to intermittent reliability issues with raw.githubusercontent.com as a test-fixture source.
